import random, math
def test():
    A=random.uniform(0.2,2.0); ph=random.uniform(0.1,1.0)
    b=random.uniform(1,3); c=random.uniform(1,3)
    p=random.uniform(0.1,2); q=random.uniform(0.1,2)
    sA=math.sin(A); s1=math.sin(A+ph); s2=math.sin(A+2*ph); sph=math.sin(ph); cph=math.cos(ph)
    D=b*c*sA-(b*p+c*q)*s1+p*q*s2
    K2=c*c-2*c*p*cph+p*p
    L2=b*b-2*b*q*cph+q*q
    powB=c*c+c*(L2*p*sph-K2*(b*sA-q*s1))/D
    powC=b*b+b*(K2*q*sph+L2*(p*s1-c*sA))/D
    ConsP=2*s1*p*p-(2*sA+s2)*c*p+c*c*s1-b*c*sph
    ConsQ=2*s1*q*q-(2*sA+s2)*b*q+b*b*s1-b*c*sph
    L4=2*s1*D*(powB-(c*c*s1-b*c*sph)/(2*s1))
    R4=c*(s1*q-b*sA)*ConsP+c*sph*p*ConsQ
    L5=2*s1*D*(powC-(b*b*s1-b*c*sph)/(2*s1))
    R5=b*sph*q*ConsP+b*(s1*p-c*sA)*ConsQ
    return L4-R4, L5-R5, max(abs(L4),abs(R4)),max(abs(L5),abs(R5))
for _ in range(8):
    print(test())
